purpose: Measure YouTube transcript routes on the requested home Mac.
firecrawl_version: REST v2; hosted server software version not exposed; no local CLI used

definitions.wall_seconds: Monotonic elapsed time including CLI startup and network calls. Baseline CLI timeout 120 seconds; REST timeout 120 seconds.
definitions.words: Lowercased Unicode word tokens, retaining internal straight or curly apostrophes.
definitions.last_timestamp: Start time of final timed segment; last_end_timestamp separately records its end.
definitions.null: Unavailable or not applicable, not measured zero.
definitions.segment_count: Timed cue count. Untimed Firecrawl text has null; nonempty line count is separate.
definitions.caption_type: Metadata inventory for failed download routes. Route 1 provenance is unspecified where manual and auto both exist. live_chat is excluded.

execution.note: Within each route the nine videos ran serially without a deliberate delay. Metadata ran while the markdown batch was finishing to select the shortest video for audio. No retry, cookies, proxy, runtime override or package upgrade was used.
